text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm walking around the
academy
with Mejiro Palmer...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! The dirt is full of rocks, and it's
choked with
weeds! This'll take forever!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
These fields are what's wrong! Prez
seemed pretty
upset about them, so I
thought I'd help her by
clearing them
out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I can help if you'd like? I'm pretty good
when it
comes to tilling soil and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Would you really?! I won't say no to
that! Thanks
a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we end up helping out in the
fields, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Here we gooo! Raaah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Diggin' holes sure gets the blood
pumping!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What the?! How'd you get so much
further along
than me?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, I did earn the nickname the
"Mejiro
Hole-Digging Champ" when I
used to play in the
dirt as a kid.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But with this much ground to cover, it'll
probably
take a few days to clear
everything out. No
biggie! Let's keep
tilling till the end!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, we arrive at the fields and
are
greeted with a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Palmer Admirers
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Palmer! We're here to
help!

text_block_list.name: Palmer Admirer A
text_block_list.text:
With this fieldwork! We heard you
needed
backup, so here we are!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Omigosh, are you for real?! Yay! Are you
all sure
you can spare the time, though?

text_block_list.name: Palmer Admirer A
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, we made sure to clear our
schedules
for today! We were talking
yesterday, you see...

text_block_list.name: Palmer Admirer A
text_block_list.text:
And we decided the least we could do
was make
the time to help you. After all,
you're always
helping us, even when
you're busy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They're not the only ones who show up
to lend a
hand either.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text:
I brought enough rice balls and drinks
for
everyone! There are plenty of side
dishes to go
around too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! Honeyade! Nothing beats
honeyade after
working really hard! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Thanks for bringing us so much
stuff! We
really appreciate it!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this is nothing. You're the one who
surveyed
everyone for us when we
couldn't decide what to
add to the
menu, remember?

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text:
So when I heard you had a big job to do,
why, I
knew I had to help out!

text_block_list.name: Cleaning Staff
text_block_list.text: Heeey! Palmer! Need a hand?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we set to work with a small army
to help
us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, that'll do! Thanks, everyone! We
couldn't
have finished so quickly without
your help!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, Teio, go ahead and tell Rudolf
that the
fields are nice and clear.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, I mean, you wanted to boast to
her about
how quickly you got the job
done, right? And how
much hard work
you put in every day to do it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh! Man, I just can't win against
you...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What?! Another submission about Palmer?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"She helped me find something I lost by
asking
around as many people as she
could and searched
for it with me right
up until curfew"...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Students are allowed to send in anything
they'd
like into our submission box, but
I'm surprised at
how many wrote
commendations for one
particular
person.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What a blessing it is that we have such a
sincere
and earnest guardian angel
supporting the
academy from the
shadows.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
President Rudolf said that about me?
Nah, she's
giving me way too much
credit!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I was surprised when I heard her say that
too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it sucks for me to hear that... but
I get
where Prez is coming from.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You know what's the most impressive
thing about
you hearing everyone out
and letting them lean
on you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's how you validate and respect
everyone's
feelings and worries!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm really grateful for your help, but I'm
not gonna
lose to you, Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm really grateful for your help, but I'm
not gonna
lose to you, Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Not you too, Trainer! Enough with the

compliments!

text_block_list.name: Cleaning Staff
text_block_list.text:
But there are still so many good things
left to say
about you! I say we should
have a party to
celebrate our hard work
and keep praising you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh! A party would be so lit! But really,
enough
with the praise!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Don't just praise Palmer! I wanna bask in

compliments too! Anyway, let's go! To
the
cafeteria!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Waheeey!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wha?! The next president?! Yeah, right!

text_block_list.name: Palmer Admirer A
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I think you could really pull
that off! I'll
plan your whole campaign!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey! I can't let that one slide! I'm gonna be the one taking over Prez's seat, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, they aren't! I'm not trying to fight
for that
seat in the first place!
